instance.task_summary: Summarize a Greek benefits-portal notice for the claimant so he can understand the claim’s status and the actions required.
givens: The user asks in Greek: «Σύνοψέ το για μένα: κατάσταση και επόμενα βήματα.»
The supplied source is a 122-word notice from the e-EFKA portal about a survivor-pension supplement claim.
The summary is for the claimant himself.

constraints.text: The concrete source text must contain between 80 and 250 words.
The summary must explain what the unfamiliar status means and what the claimant must do next.
Use clear language suitable for the claimant reading his own case update.
Combine the status explanation, response deadline, and required documents without losing any condition.

instance.packet: Η αίτησή σας για την προσαύξηση σύνταξης λόγω θανάτου, με αριθμό υπόθεσης ΠΑ-18427/2026, εμφανίζεται πλέον ως «Σε διοικητικό έλεγχο – αναμονή συμπληρωματικών στοιχείων». Η ένδειξη αυτή δεν σημαίνει απόρριψη. Κατά τον έλεγχο διαπιστώθηκε ότι λείπει πρόσφατο πιστοποιητικό οικογενειακής κατάστασης και ευκρινές αντίγραφο της πρώτης σελίδας του τραπεζικού λογαριασμού όπου αναγράφονται το IBAN και το ονοματεπώνυμό σας. Τα δύο αρχεία πρέπει να μεταφορτωθούν σε μορφή PDF έως τις 2 Οκτωβρίου 2026, από την επιλογή «Οι αιτήσεις μου» και έπειτα «Προσθήκη δικαιολογητικών». Κάθε αρχείο δεν πρέπει να υπερβαίνει τα 5 MB. Αν τα στοιχεία δεν υποβληθούν εμπρόθεσμα, η εξέταση θα ανασταλεί, αλλά η αίτηση δεν θα διαγραφεί. Μετά την υποβολή, δεν απαιτείται επίσκεψη σε υπηρεσία. Θα λάβετε νέο μήνυμα όταν ολοκληρωθεί ο έλεγχος.
instance.deliverable: A concise Greek summary for the claimant that states the status is not a rejection, identifies both missing documents, gives the deadline and upload route, notes the 5 MB PDF limit, and explains the consequence of late submission and what happens afterward.
instance.answer_conditions: Respond in Greek. Explain in plain terms that the claim is awaiting documents rather than rejected. Preserve the exact deadline of 2 October 2026, case number ΠΑ-18427/2026 if useful, both required documents, PDF format, 5 MB per-file limit, portal path, suspension consequence, no required office visit, and later notification. Do not add medical or cooking content.

instance.task_summary: Classify a specific church account book using only the archival definitions and record details in a pasted research excerpt, and justify the classification.
givens: The user asks: «Με βάση το απόσπασμα, πώς ταξινομείται το βιβλίο Β-17; Αιτιολόγησε.»
The pasted excerpt defines an archival fonds, a series, and an item.
Book Β-17 contains the church community's income and expenses for 2018–2020 and belongs with 12 similar consecutive account books.

constraints.text: The classification and justification must rely only on the pasted excerpt.
The response must give both the archival level and the relevant series, then justify both choices from the definitions and facts provided.
Answer in Greek.

instance.packet: Σε ένα εκκλησιαστικό αρχείο, «αρχείο φορέα» είναι το σύνολο των εγγράφων που δημιούργησε και διατήρησε ο ίδιος οργανισμός κατά τη λειτουργία του. «Σειρά» είναι ομάδα εγγράφων που προέκυψαν από την ίδια δραστηριότητα και τηρούνται με σταθερή μορφή ή διαδοχική αρίθμηση. «Τεκμήριο» είναι μία αυτοτελής μονάδα μέσα σε σειρά, όπως ένα βιβλίο ή ένας φάκελος. Το βιβλίο Β-17 καταγράφει τα έσοδα και τα έξοδα της κοινότητας από το 2018 έως το 2020. Φυλάσσεται μαζί με δώδεκα παρόμοια, διαδοχικά αριθμημένα λογιστικά βιβλία της ίδιας κοινότητας.
instance.deliverable: A concise Greek classification of book Β-17 as an item within the financial-management/account-books series of the community's fonds, with a text-grounded justification.
instance.answer_conditions: The answer must identify Β-17 as a «τεκμήριο», place it in a «σειρά» of accounting or financial-management books, and recognize that this series belongs to the community's «αρχείο φορέα». It must justify the item classification because Β-17 is one autonomous book, and the series classification because the books arise from the same income-and-expense activity and are consecutively numbered. No outside archival conventions should be introduced.

instance.task_summary: Write a concise Greek message to the family business’s regular shipping agent clarifying which ferry option must be decided during an imminent call.
givens: The recipient is Eleni, the shipping agent who regularly arranges the family beekeeping business’s harvest consignments.
The call begins in ten minutes.
The consignment is 18 κιβώτια μέλι for 19 Σεπτεμβρίου.
The two quoted departures under discussion are 20:00 to Heraklion and 22:30 to Chania.
The sender needs to know whether the call will choose the route or only confirm loading requirements.

constraints.text: The message must sound calm and organized, without blaming Eleni for the unclear agenda.

constraints.params: two alternatives and explicit agenda question
constraints.text: Mention both quoted departures and ask whether the call is for selecting one of them or merely confirming loading requirements.
Keep the Greek message brief enough to send immediately.

instance.deliverable: A ready-to-send Greek message to Eleni.
instance.answer_conditions: The response must produce only a concise Greek message that identifies the shipment and both ferry options, then clearly distinguishes the two possible purposes of the call. It must preserve the professional ongoing relationship and avoid implying that the quoted departures have been independently verified.

instance.task_summary: Draft a narrowly limited Greek authorization letter allowing the artist’s studio assistant to accompany a stairwell measurement visit for a shelving unit.
givens: The letter is addressed to the apartment-building manager, Mr. Nikos Lembesis.
The sender authorizes her studio assistant, Anna Frangou, to enter the common stairwell with a carpenter on 23 Σεπτεμβρίου 2026, from 10:00–11:00.
They may only measure the access route for a shelving unit sized 198 × 92 × 48 εκ.
The authorization must not permit ordering work, moving residents’ property, accepting delivery, or approving charges.

constraints.text: Use formal Greek suitable for a building manager.
Explicitly limit the authorization to access and measurements during the stated hour and exclude works, delivery acceptance, movement of property, and financial commitments.
Include a subject line, salutation, authorization statement, and spaces for the sender’s name, signature, and date.

instance.deliverable: A formal Greek authorization letter ready for the sender to complete and sign.
instance.answer_conditions: The letter must authorize Anna Frangou and the accompanying carpenter only to inspect and measure the common stairwell in the specified time window. It must expressly withhold authority to commission work, move property, receive the shelving unit, or approve any expense, while remaining courteous to the building manager.

instance.task_summary: Write a tightly constrained warning for volunteers at a new neighborhood library about a suspicious delivery-fee email impersonating NZ Post.
givens: The audience is volunteers at a new neighborhood library.
The suspicious email appears to be from NZ Post and requests a $3.25 payment concerning donated books.

constraints.text: The warning must contain exactly 70 words, counting the heading.

constraints.params: one heading followed by three bullets
constraints.text: Use a heading first and exactly three bullet points after it.
Do not include any hyperlinks or web addresses.
End with a bullet advising volunteers to verify the message independently by phone.

instance.deliverable: A concise English fraud-warning notice for neighborhood-library volunteers.
instance.answer_conditions: The response must have exactly 70 words in total, including the heading; contain one heading followed by exactly three bullets; identify the NZ Post $3.25 donated-book email as suspicious without declaring conclusively that NZ Post sent it; contain no URL or hyperlink; and make independent telephone verification the final bullet.

instance.task_summary: Politely edit a Greek note to a neighbor about a storm-loosened roofing sheet while preserving every concrete detail exactly.
givens: The sender is a 71-year-old pensioner in Skopelos who maintains the Μονοπάτι Αγίου Ρηγίνου.
A neighbor's loose metal roofing sheet is disturbing the sender's sleep and obstructing a footpath used by 18 schoolchildren.

constraints.text: Make the note polite without weakening the practical request.

constraints.params: all names, dates, times, quantities, locations, and event details
constraints.text: Do not change any concrete detail from the pasted draft.

instance.packet: Κύριε Αντώνη, από την καταιγίδα της 14ης Σεπτεμβρίου 2026 η λαμαρίνα στην αποθήκη σας χτυπά κάθε νύχτα, κυρίως 00:30–04:00, και δεν μπορώ να κοιμηθώ. Στις 16 Σεπτεμβρίου ένα κομμάτι έπεσε στο Μονοπάτι Αγίου Ρηγίνου, το οποίο καθαρίζω εθελοντικά και χρησιμοποιούν καθημερινά 18 παιδιά για να πάνε στο σχολείο. Θα ήθελα να τη στερεώσετε έως την Παρασκευή 18 Σεπτεμβρίου, στις 18:00. Αν χρειάζεστε βοήθεια για να απομακρύνουμε το πεσμένο κομμάτι, μπορώ να έρθω μαζί σας.
instance.deliverable: A polished Greek version of the note.
instance.answer_conditions: The response must provide only or primarily the edited Greek note, use a courteous and non-accusatory tone, and preserve verbatim every check value plus the stated causal and factual relationships. It must retain both concerns: nighttime sleep disruption and the obstruction affecting schoolchildren. It must not add cloud-type information or invent facts.

instance.task_summary: Explain where to locate the livestock holding code requested for an insurance policy, using a rigid two-bullet format.
givens: The person needs the «κωδικό εκμετάλλευσης» for an insurance policy.

constraints.text: The response must contain exactly two bullet points.
The final bullet must end with the exact word «μητρώο».

instance.deliverable: A concise Greek explanation identifying the likely document or registry where the livestock holding code appears.
instance.answer_conditions: Respond in Greek with exactly two bullet points and end the entire response with «μητρώο». Explain that the code is normally found on the livestock-holding registration certificate or related veterinary-service record, distinguish it from an individual animal ear-tag number, and briefly request the form issuer or field label if the intended code cannot be identified confidently.

instance.task_summary: Troubleshoot a MacBook that became extremely slow after a macOS update and provide an offline-safe sequence of checks and remedies.
givens: The user has a 2019 MacBook Air running macOS Sonoma 14.7.
The laptop became extremely slow immediately after the 14.7 update.
The user already restarted it twice.
Activity Monitor shows the process “mds_stores” using 85–95% CPU even when no applications are open.
The user needs instructions that remain usable without an internet connection.

constraints.text: Explain what the observed process is doing, then give ordered checks and safe remedies.
All core diagnostic and recovery steps must work offline.

instance.deliverable: A concise, ordered offline troubleshooting procedure that preserves the doctor’s local patient files.
instance.answer_conditions: Explain that Spotlight reindexing after an update is a likely cause but not yet proven. Provide a safe sequence: keep the Mac powered and awake for indexing, check free storage and CPU behavior, exclude only an appropriate nonclinical folder if necessary, and use Safe Mode or First Aid if the load does not subside. Warn against disabling Spotlight globally or deleting indexes without a backup, and prioritize protection of patient data.

instance.task_summary: Restore notification sounds for one muted iPhone Messages conversation so supportive texts reach the user’s daughter during her Greek university entrance exams.
givens: The user’s daughter is having a difficult week while preparing for the Greek university entrance exams.
On his iPhone 13, her Messages conversation shows “Delivered,” but she says her replies produce no alert on his phone.
He already turned the phone’s volume up.
A crossed-out bell appears beside her conversation, while other conversations still make sounds.

constraints.text: Change the alert setting only for the daughter’s conversation.

instance.deliverable: The single setting change needed to restore alerts for that Messages conversation.
instance.answer_conditions: Identify the crossed-out bell as Hide Alerts being enabled for that conversation and give the direct one-step fix: swipe left on the conversation and tap the bell, or open it, tap the contact name, and turn off Hide Alerts. Do not suggest changing global notification settings because other conversations already alert normally.

instance.task_summary: A cardiology nurse asks in Greek why a mathematically boundary-located address can be rejected and how strict and inclusive inequalities differ.
givens: The address is correctly formatted.
Its coordinates are 23,7581 and 37,9846.
The application places the location on its service-area boundary but rejects it.
The user believes every boundary point must belong to the represented region and asks about < versus ≤.

constraints.text: The request is written in Greek.
Use one compact request with only the facts needed for the explanation.
Distinguish address validity from membership in a mathematically defined service region, including strict versus inclusive boundaries.

instance.deliverable: A concise mathematical and intuitive explanation of open and closed boundary conditions and why the portal may reject the point.
instance.answer_conditions: Explain that x< c excludes equality while x≤c includes it; membership of a boundary point depends on the inequalities defining the region, not on a universal rule. Separate a correctly formatted address from geofence membership. Note briefly that rounding or coordinate precision can affect implementation behavior, without asserting that this is the actual cause.

instance.task_summary: A retired shopkeeper asks in English why fortnightly visits and same-date monthly visits that begin together do not continue to coincide.
givens: Both visit schedules begin on 5 January 2027.
One visit repeats every 14 days.
The other repeats on the fifth day of every month.
The user expects schedules that start together to remain together.

constraints.text: The request is written in English.
Use only the mathematical ask and its defining date and recurrence descriptions.
The explanation must generate dates under both recurrence rules and compare them.

instance.deliverable: A simple explanation, with the first subsequent dates, showing why the two recurrence patterns diverge.
instance.answer_conditions: Interpret fortnightly as every 14 days and same-date monthly as the fifth of each month. Show that the next dates are 19 January 2027 and 5 February 2027 respectively, so they immediately diverge. Explain that calendar months contain varying numbers of days and are not equivalent to a fixed 14-day multiple.
